name.value: Ramada by Wyndham Northern Grand Hotel & Conference Centre

description.value: A full-service six-storey Ramada by Wyndham franchise hotel in Fort St. John, in the Peace River region of northeastern BC. The property includes conference facilities, making it one of the larger hotel options in this northern community along the Alaska Highway corridor. Touring cyclists passing through on long-distance routes would find it a convenient urban base with standard hotel services.
